title: Our415: a directory, not a record of activity
question: Can the Our415 tables show youth programs listed as running with no activity?
finding: The Our415 tables can show little about activity. 399 of the 3,281 services with categories have any weekly schedule; 20 schedule rows carry an end date before the day the data were drawn. The 2,363 events come from 2 City departments (SF Rec Park, SF Public Library), not from grantees. The organization and service names are in tables not published here, so no entry can be joined to a grant. The City's contract for the site, 1000033328, was for $224,770; $51,840 was paid against it.
how: Taxonomy link ids for services and organizations set against schedule service ids and contact organization ids; contract found by title in the supplier contracts file and its payments in the vouchers file.
limits: A directory lists what organizations tell it; a missing schedule means the hours were not entered, not that nothing runs. Activity would need the services table and the grantee year-end reports.
